title: One-command autonomous task orchestrator
constraints: Use Codex CLI as the autonomous default provider.
Never use clipboard, AppleScript, simulated input, mouse automation, or Antigravity UI automation.
Bind corrections to task, holder, lease, fencing version, worktree, previous commit, and failure code.
Limit automatic product correction rounds to three.
Do not weaken lifecycle, verifier, receipt, path, or capability controls.
degradedBehavior: Fail closed with a stable error code, release no authority implicitly, and preserve resumable state.
rollback: Revert the single framework-task commit; existing manual lifecycle commands remain available.
stopConditions: The framework task source hash differs from the compiled contract.
A product task remains active during framework bootstrap.
A requested provider lacks a supported headless prompt-and-wait interface.
Implementation would weaken trusted verification or lease fencing.
completionDefinition: One command discovers, resumes, verifies, corrects, merges, cleans, and continues tasks.
Lease renewal and recovery require no owner intervention.
Codex CLI runs headlessly and correction rounds stop after three.
Dry-run/status smoke testing starts no product implementation.
One atomic task commit passes trusted verification.
